newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch tourist discovers exotic lizard in luggage.
newsitem.headline: Dutch tourist discovers exotic lizard in luggage.

text.p: A Dutch holidaymaker returning from the Caribbean island of Isla Margarita was shocked to find an iguana dozing in his suitcase when he unpacked, Rotterdam police said on Friday.

"We think smugglers planted the drugged lizard in his luggage with the aim of retrieving it before his case was returned at (Amsterdam airport) Schiphol," police spokeswoman Angelique van Campen said.
She said the find had been reported to customs authorities, who were investigating.
"Funnily enough the man did go through the red 'anything to declare' channel at Schiphol, but that was because he had too many cigarettes," she said.
